scope: S0 autonomous infrastructure acceptance only; no Rust parity or live provider success is implied.

scenarios.action: Run compare.ts and self-check.ts on two independently retained oracle runs.
assertions: all five complete observations match
six damaged evidence variants rejected
scenarios.negativeCase: Changed semantic output or raw data accepted after recomputing only a hash.

scenarios.action: Run corpus-compare.ts and corpus-self-check.ts on two independent 23-case corpus runs.
assertions: all 23 complete observations match
seven damaged corpus variants rejected
scenarios.negativeCase: Failed RUN or inconsistent manifest accepted.

scenarios.action: Build the pinned release binary and execute scripts/probe/migration/resources.py under its bounded Linux PTY protocol.
assertions: binary/source/script identities and all manifest hashes verified
empty and 1000-turn history windows completed
stream and cancel observations retained
both TUI runs exited zero without forced cleanup
scenarios.negativeCase: A dead child, truncated output, missing observation or forced exit is reported as a valid resource baseline.

scenarios.action: Scan the selected TS checkout, compare every entry to reviewed fixed dispositions and check all capability/scenario references, input hashes and stage deadlines.
assertions: every scanned entry has one explicit disposition
no unclassified source delta
all preservation requirements have linked scenarios
independent semantic review has no unresolved Blocking or Should-fix
scenarios.negativeCase: A new entry or changed source hash silently reuses an old classification.

scenarios.action: Run required TS lint/typecheck/tests/doctor, evidence corruption tests, docs synchronization/changelog pairing and relevant migration checks; retain commands and skips.
assertions: lint and typecheck passed
required deterministic tests passed with unavailable live lanes explicitly skipped
doctor reported no missing required runtime inputs
evidence checker rejects missing entry wrong hash and skipped-as-pass
scenarios.negativeCase: A skipped/unavailable result becomes passing evidence or a failed required check is ignored.

scenarios.action: Bind accepted stage slices to exact heads, independent reviews and actual source/package/Linux/native Windows CI jobs; document owner-waived Bot separately.
assertions: independent applicable reviews resolved
required CI jobs passed at accepted heads
native Windows consumer evidence is actual Windows CI
Bot is owner-waived and never labeled passed
scenarios.negativeCase: Evidence from another commit/platform or a truncated Bot result is presented as a successful required check.

scenarios.action: Run routing regressions and an isolated synthetic Cargo workspace; prove Rust/build changes cannot bypass review and every Cargo phase uses the exact pin.
assertions: all Rust inputs trigger all five review lenses
incomplete or orphan workspace rejected
synthetic pinned Cargo phases executed
absent application Rust workspace explicitly skipped
scenarios.negativeCase: Tiny/deleted Rust input avoids review or inherited cargo ignores the pin.

resourceConditions.thresholds: observations only, no performance pass threshold
